blocks.tamil_translation: even on seeing the people of that city disobey, the colour of that man's face never changed even for a moment,” Allah Ta'ala said. Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates this hadith.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The essence of this hadith is: it is true that that servant of Mine never disobeyed Me, but while people were committing sins before him, he watched it calmly; is that sin a small one? Evils are spreading and people are disobeying Allah Ta'ala, yet on seeing the evils not even the slightest sign of dislike was seen on his face.
(Mirqat)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ دُرَّةَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي لَهَبٍ ﵂ قَالَتْ: قَامَ رَجُلٌ إِلَي النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهُوَ عَلَي الْمِنْبَرِ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ! أَيُّ النَّاسِ خَيْرٌ؟ قَالَ: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ أَقْرَؤُهُمْ وَأَتْقَاهُمْ وَآمُرُهُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَأَنْهَاهُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَأَوْصَلُهُمْ لِلرَّحِمِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد وهذا لفظه، والطبراني ورجالهما ثقات وفي بعضهم كلام لا يضر، مجمع الزوائد:٧ /٥٢٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Durrah bint Abi Lahab (RA) says, “While Rasulullah ﷺ was seated on the minbar, a man stood up and asked, “O Rasulullah, who is the best of people?” Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “The best of people is the one who recites the Qur'an more than everyone, who fears Allah more than everyone, who enjoins good and keeps people away from evil more than everyone, and who keeps ties with relatives more than everyone.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَي كِسْرَي، وَإِلَي قَيْصَرَ،
